title: Normalized comparisons for the total-derived open adjunction
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E of Q_ell, and a field k of positive characteristic different from ell. The compactification composites and total derived open adjunctions of [def-sfb-integral-compact-support-interface], with integral coefficient O_E, admit one comparison family satisfying identity, cocycle, and normalization against every boundary-preserving refinement. This is the total-derived normalization of [det-sf-comp-coherence-cocycle].

source.place: Final paragraph, comparison, composition and base-change normalization.

proof.text: Restrict the canonical compactification comparison family from Loc(Dctf) to Loc(Dbc) using localizingClosure_ctf_equals_bc for O_E. Whiskering preserves its identity and cocycle equations.

For r:c→d choose a dense refinement a:w→c using the common dense refinement of c with itself. Apply canonical comparison normalization to a and a followed by r. The refinement-component composition law and cancellation of the invertible component for a give phi(c,d) rho_r = id.

Apply the single-refinement total normalization lemma to obtain e and identify rho_r with the inverse of refinementIso(e). The cancellation equation identifies phi(c,d) with this isomorphism. Assemble the per-morphism families by choice.

proof_origin.place: Final comparison paragraph; total-derived normalization of one boundary refinement. M6: restricted canonical family and dense-refinement cancellation.

from.place: Final paragraph, comparison, composition and base-change normalization.

lean.statement:
theorem normalizedComparisons
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ) [Fact (ringChar k).Prime] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ ℓ)]
    : ∃ φ : Comparisons (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) k,
      (∀ {X Y : Spaces k} (f : X ⟶ Y) (c : Compactifications k f),
    φ f c c = Iso.refl _) ∧
      (∀ {X Y : Spaces k} (f : X ⟶ Y) (c d e : Compactifications k f),
    φ f c d ≪≫ φ f d e = φ f c e) ∧
      (∀ {X Y : Spaces k} (f : X ⟶ Y) (c d : Compactifications k f)
    (r : c.obj.Refinement d.obj)
    (_boundary : r.hom ⁻¹ᵁ d.obj.i.opensRange = c.obj.i.opensRange)
    (K : (localizing (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) X.obj.left).FullSubcategory),
      ∃ e : (extend (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) d.obj.i).obj K.obj ≅
          (push (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) r.hom).obj ((extend
            (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) c.obj.i).obj K.obj),
        (openAdjunction (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) d.obj.i).homEquiv _ _ e.hom ≫
            refinementRestriction (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) r K.obj =
              (openAdjunction (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) c.obj.i).unit.app K.obj ∧
          (φ f c d).app K = refinementIso (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) r K.obj e)
